Class BenchmarkResultsStore

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.benchmarks.BenchmarkResultsStore
public class BenchmarkResultsStore extends Object
Generic persistence store and manager for JSON-formatted benchmark run telemetry and scorecards.

Provides decoupled reading, updating, and saving of BenchmarkRunResult records to any designated JSON file path on disk without suite-specific hardcoding.

    • submitJudgeScore

      public static boolean submitJudgeScore(Path resultsFile, BenchmarkParticipant participant, String judgeName, double score) throws IOException
      Adds or updates a judge's score for a specific run in a results file.
      Parameters:
      resultsFile - The path to the JSON results file.
      participant - The composite candidate participant key (providerUuid, modelId, thinkingLevel).
      judgeName - The name of the judge (e.g. "Pablo", "Vijay").
      score - The score given by the judge.
      Returns:
      true if a matching run was found and updated, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IOException - If saving fails.
